ClassII_scope: 15-mers across nine conditional chain combinations; synthetic junction-spanning 9-aa cores are minimized in CP-SAT (0 at <=0.5%, 12 at <=2.0%), while input-region 9-aa cores whose 15-mer window extends across an engineered linker/boundary (1-4 flanking linker/adjacent residues; includes mutant or wild-type input cores) are reported separately (9 at <=2.0%).
count_unit: Placed peptide-HLA pairs; repeated peptide occurrences count separately.
scope: Model-dependent rankings, not unwanted T-cell responses. PRIME and MixMHCpred are correlated; percentile scales are not interchangeable.
